source.title: Some recent open problems under strong connections between Pareto efficiency, the potential theory and related topics.

evidence.quote: Some recent open problems under strong connections between Pareto efficiency, the potential theory and related topics.

Summary: This research paper contains some open problems concerning the Pareto efficiency with respect to the supernormal cones and the first main connection established by us, in a previous work, between two great fields of Mathematics: Vectorial Optimization and Potential Theory, with the immediate implications in multi-objective and goal programming.

trace.notes: Normalized the user input as a zbMATH bibliographic landing page for Zbl 1125.90408.

The zbMATH page exposed bibliographic metadata and a summary, but no visible full-text problem statements. A direct fetch of the linked zbMATH review PDF returned HTTP 403, and exact-title web searches did not recover a readable copy of the same work.
Moved the item to needs_review because the resolved source remained metadata-only and therefore did not provide adequate verbatim problem statements for extraction or self-contained rewriting.
Saved exact JSON to outputs/parse-paper/2227386.json and outputs/latest.json.
